nodes.label: Spaced Repetition Visual Metaphor
nodes.rationale: The icon encodes the product's core loop rather than a literal object: the two offset cards read as a deck of flashcards, the circular arrow with an arrowhead reads as 'review again', and the wink (one eye, no second eye) puns on the product name 'Blink' while suggesting a fast, low-effort recall moment. Depth is achieved with a single rotated, low-opacity duplicate rather than shadows so the mark stays crisp at small app-icon sizes; the rx=50 squircle and flat two-stop gradient keep it legible against both iOS and Android icon masks.
